findings.title: BATTERY DISCHARGE, MONTH BY MONTH
findings.fact: ERCOT: the month's battery discharge, MWh, summed from the daily cycle table, 770,026 MWh in September 2026, up from 338,301 MWh in December 2024. The direction holds in 21 of the 21 complete months after December 2024.

findings.title: BATTERY DISCHARGE IN THE EVENING, MONTH BY MONTH
findings.fact: ERCOT: share of the month's battery discharge (hourly net battery output above zero) delivered from 5 PM to 10 PM local, 85.8 percent of discharge in September 2026, up from 47.6 percent of discharge in December 2024. The direction holds in 19 of the 21 complete months after December 2024.

findings.title: CURTAILMENT, THIS YEAR SO FAR
findings.fact: CAISO: curtailed wind and solar output from 1 January to 30 September, MWh was 5,115,404 MWh in 2026, the highest of the 12 complete years held; the previous high was 3,452,749 MWh in 2025.

findings.title: TILL QUEUE DO US PART, BY COHORT
findings.fact: PJM: share of the MW that entered PJM's queue in the year and had withdrawn by the end of 2025 (cohorts at least six years old), 63.3 percent of the cohort's MW in 2019, down from 88.7 percent of the cohort's MW in 2010. The direction holds in 9 of the 9 complete years after 2010.

findings.title: BATTERY DISCHARGE, MONTH BY MONTH
findings.fact: CAISO: the month's battery discharge, MWh, summed from the daily cycle table, 1,335,586 MWh in September 2026, up from 1,105,004 MWh in September 2025. The direction holds in 10 of the 12 complete months after September 2025.

findings.title: THE QUEUE'S BIGGEST YEAR
findings.fact: ERCOT: MW of generation and storage that entered ERCOT's interconnection queue in the year, every status, as LBNL's Queued Up data file records it was 85,405 MW in 2024, the highest of the 21 complete years held; the previous high was 66,858 MW in 2023.

findings.title: TILL QUEUE DO US PART, BY COHORT
findings.fact: CAISO: share of the MW that entered CAISO's queue in the year and had withdrawn by the end of 2025 (cohorts at least six years old), 60.0 percent of the cohort's MW in 2019, down from 83.4 percent of the cohort's MW in 2010. The direction holds in 5 of the 9 complete years after 2010.

findings.title: HOURS BELOW ZERO, THIS YEAR SO FAR
findings.fact: ERCOT, the West hub: share of the 15-minute intervals from 1 January to 25 August with a real-time price below zero at the West hub was 15.95 percent of intervals in 2026, the highest of the 12 complete years held; the previous high was 13.49 percent of intervals in 2022.

findings.title: WIND AND SOLAR CURTAILED
findings.fact: CAISO: share of the year's wind and solar output that was curtailed: curtailed over curtailed plus generated, 4.53 percent of output in 2025, up from 0.67 percent of output in 2015. The direction holds in 10 of the 10 complete years after 2015.
findings.shown_before: the weekly hunt's draft of 13 October 2026 (block 19)

findings.title: THE PEAK PREMIUM
findings.fact: ERCOT, the hub average: the year's median evening-peak real-time price minus its median midday price at the hub average (ercot_peak_premium_annual), 14.52 USD per MWh in 2025, up from -0.16 USD per MWh in 2015. The direction holds in 10 of the 10 complete years after 2015.
